integrity.literature_risk: General integral equivariant cellular complexes predate this calculation, and equivalent unpublished/unindexed results cannot be excluded.
integrity.mathematical_proof: Explicit pair-homotopy reduction, unordered rose-cell differential, and unimodular integral diagonal form; standalone finite exact checks are supporting tests, not an infinite proof.

scientific_limitations: Exact integral Borel–Moore homology only for three unlabeled collision-free particles on finite connected graphs; it does not determine ordinary singular configuration homology or higher-particle groups.
title: Integral Borel–Moore homology of unordered triples on connected graphs
